arxiv-1807-08679.title: On a Potential Game-theoretic Approach to Event-triggered Distributed Resource Allocation
arxiv-1807-08679.creator: Prashant Bansode, Sharad Jadhav, Mukesh Patil, Navdeep Singh
arxiv-1807-08679.description: Abstract This paper proposes a potential game theoretic approach to address event-triggered distributed resource allocation in multi-agent systems. The fitness dynamic of the population is proposed and exploited as a linear parameter-varying dynamic to achieve the event-triggered distributed resource allocation. Firstly, it is shown that the dynamic resembles a consensus protocol and is equivalent to the replicator dynamic.

arxiv-1809-05164.title: Exact Markovian and non-Markovian time dynamics in waveguide QED: collective interactions, bound states in continuum, superradiance and subradiance
arxiv-1809-05164.creator: Fatih Dinc, İlke Ercan, Agata M. Brańczyk
arxiv-1809-05164.description: Abstract We develop a formalism for modelling exact time dynamics in waveguide quantum electrodynamics (QED) using the real-space approach. The formalism does not assume any specific configuration of emitters and allows the study of Markovian dynamics fully analytically and non-Markovian dynamics semi-analytically with a simple numerical integration step.

arxiv-2310-17512.title: CompeteAI: Understanding the Competition Dynamics of Large Language Model-based Agents
arxiv-2310-17512.creator: Qinlin Zhao, Jindong Wang, Yixuan Zhang, Yiqiao Jin, Kaijie Zhu, Hao Chen, Xing Xie
arxiv-2310-17512.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have been widely used as agents to complete different tasks, such as personal assistance or event planning. While most of the work has focused on cooperation and collaboration between agents, little work explores competition , another important mechanism that promotes the development of society and economy.

arxiv-2312-07520.title: Estimating Counterfactual Matrix Means with Short Panel Data Thanks: First version: December 11, 2023. Authors are listed alphabetically. We thank Alberto Abadie, Dmitry Arkhangelsky, Susan Athey, Mohsen Bayati, Stéphane Bonhomme, Kirill Borusyak, Jiafeng Chen, Rebecca Diamond, Matthew Gentzkow, Bry
arxiv-2312-07520.creator: Lihua Lei, Brad Ross
arxiv-2312-07520.description: Abstract We develop a new, spectral approach for identifying and estimating average counterfactual outcomes under a low-rank factor model with short panel data and general outcome missingness patterns. Applications include event studies and studies of outcomes of “matches” between agents of two types, e.g. workers and firms, typically conducted under less-flexible Two-Way-Fixed-Effects (TWFE) models of outcomes.

arxiv-2404-10254.title: The Thousand-Pulsar-Array programme on MeerKAT XIV: On the high linearly polarized pulsar signals
arxiv-2404-10254.creator: Simon Johnston, Dipanjan Mitra, Michael J. Keith, Lucy S. Oswald, Aris Karastergiou
arxiv-2404-10254.description: Abstract The S-shaped swing of the linear polarization position angle (PPA) observed in many pulsars can be interpreted by the rotating vector model (RVM). However, efforts to fit the RVM for a large sample of pulsars observed with the MeerKAT telescope as a part of the Thousand-Pulsar-Array (TPA) programme, only succeeded for about half the cases.

arxiv-2404-18647.title: Nonequilibrium Nonlinear Effects and Dynamical Boson Condensation in a Driven-Dissipative Wannier-Stark Lattice
arxiv-2404-18647.creator: Arkadiusz Kosior, Karol Gietka, Farokh Mivehvar, Helmut Ritsch
arxiv-2404-18647.description: Abstract Driven-dissipative light-matter systems can exhibit collective nonequilibrium phenomena due to loss and gain processes on the one hand and effective photon-photon interactions on the other hand. As generic example we study a bosonic lattice system implemented via an array of driven-dissipative coupled nonlinear resonators with linearly increasing resonance frequencies across the lattice.

arxiv-2408-13435.title: Prototype of Secure Wire-Line Telephone Thanks: This work was jointly supported by the Science and Technology Project of Guangzhou under Grants 202206010118 and 2023B04J0011, and the National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grant 62171006. The calculations were supported by the High-Perfor
arxiv-2408-13435.creator: Lifeng Lin, Zijian Zhou, Peihe Jiang, Sanjun Liu
arxiv-2408-13435.description: Abstract This paper presents a secure wire-line telephone system that employs physical layer security (PLS) to protect against wiretapping. The system generates artificial noise (AN) in both transmission directions and uses a telephone hybrid circuit to effectively suppress the AN for the purpose of secure communication.

arxiv-2408-14049.title: A general theory for the ( s , p ) (s,p) -superposition of nonlinear fractional operators
arxiv-2408-14049.creator: Serena Dipierro, Edoardo Proietti Lippi, Caterina Sportelli and Enrico Valdinoci
arxiv-2408-14049.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Serena Dipierro, Edoardo Proietti Lippi, Caterina Sportelli and Enrico Valdinoci. We consider the continuous superposition of operators of the form ∬ [ 0 , 1 ] × ( 1 , N ) ( − Δ ) p s ​ u ​ 𝑑 μ ​ ( s , p ) , \iint_{[0,1]\times(1,N)}(-\Delta)_{p}^{s}\,u\,d\mu(s,p), where μ \mu denotes a signed measure over the set [ 0 , 1 ] × ( 1 , N ) [0,1]\times(1,N) , joined to a nonlinearity satisfying a proper subcritical growth.

arxiv-2409-04768.title: Medical Image Segmentation via Single-Source Domain Generalization with Random Amplitude Spectrum Synthesis
arxiv-2409-04768.creator: Qiang Qiao İD, Wenyu Wang İD, Meixia Qu İD, Kun Su İD, Bin Jiang (🖂) İD, Qiang Guo (🖂) İD
arxiv-2409-04768.description: Abstract The field of medical image segmentation is challenged by domain generalization (DG) due to domain shifts in clinical datasets. The DG challenge is exacerbated by the scarcity of medical data and privacy concerns. Traditional single-source domain generalization (SSDG) methods primarily rely on stacking data augmentation techniques to minimize domain discrepancies.

arxiv-2411-16261.title: Almost-fuchsian representations in SU ⁡ ( 2 , 1 ) \mathrm{SU}(2,1)
arxiv-2411-16261.creator: samuel bronstein
arxiv-2411-16261.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study nonmaximal representations of surface groups in PU ⁡ ( 2 , 1 ) \mathrm{PU}(2,1) . In genus large enough, we show the existence of convex-cocompact representations of non-maximal Toledo invariant admitting a unique equivariant minimal surface, which is holomorphic and almost totally geodesic.

arxiv-2502-06944.title: Emergence of a neutrino flux above 5 PeV and implications for ultrahigh-energy cosmic rays
arxiv-2502-06944.creator: Marco S. Muzio, Tianlu Yuan, Lu Lu
arxiv-2502-06944.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marco S. Muzio, Tianlu Yuan, Lu Lu. The rare detections of astrophysical neutrinos with energies above 5 PeV 5\text{\,}\mathrm{PeV} by two neutrino telescopes underscore the existence of a flux at these energies. In addition to over a decade of data taken by the IceCube Neutrino Observatory, the KM3NeT neutrino telescope has recently highlighted their discovery of a possible 𝒪 ⁡ ( 100 PeV ) \mathcal{O}($100\text{\,}\mathrm{PeV}$) neutrino candidate. A connection between the highest-energy astrophysical neutrinos and the highest-energy cosmic rays is expected, and well-established theoretically.

arxiv-2506-04061.title: Collaborative On-Sensor Array Cameras 986 Journal: TOG Volume: 44 4 8 DOI: 10.1145/3731200 CCS: Computing methodologies Computational photography; Massively parallel algorithms
arxiv-2506-04061.creator: Jipeng Sun, Kaixuan Wei, Thomas Eboli, Congli Wang, Cheng Zheng, Zhihao Zhou, Arka Majumdar, Wolfgang Heidrich, Felix Heide
arxiv-2506-04061.description: Abstract . Modern nanofabrication techniques have enabled us to manipulate the wavefront of light with sub-wavelength-scale structures, offering the potential to replace bulky refractive surfaces in conventional optics with ultrathin metasurfaces. In theory, arrays of nanoposts provide unprecedented control over manipulating the wavefront in terms of phase, polarization, and amplitude at the nanometer resolution.

arxiv-2512-23681.title: Better than squareroot cancellation in number theory Thanks: This research was funded in part by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council of the United Kingdom [grant EP/V055755/1]. For the purpose of open access, the author has applied a Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY) licence to
arxiv-2512-23681.creator: Adam J Harper
arxiv-2512-23681.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Adam J Harper. We give a short survey of the phenomenon of better than squareroot cancellation, specifically as it applies to averages of multiplicative character sums (such as 1 r − 1 ​ ∑ χ ​ mod ​ r | ∑ n ≤ x χ ⁡ ( n ) | 2 ​ q \frac{1}{r-1}\sum_{\chi\;\text{mod}\;r}|\sum_{n\leq x}\chi(n)|^{2q} ) thanks to their connection with so-called multiplicative chaos. We focus on the number theoretic aspects of the arguments, and also touch on some possible applications.

plos-pone-0351142.title: Perspectives on preconception care in Ethiopia: Social, cultural, and structural determinants
plos-pone-0351142.creator: Yared Asmare Aynalem, Pauline Paul, Zohra S. Lassi, Salima Meherali
plos-pone-0351142.description: Perspectives on preconception care in Ethiopia: Social, cultural, and structural determinants

pmc-10686022.title: Acute liver failure and aplastic crisis due to anorexia nervosa in an adolescent girl: a case report
pmc-10686022.creator: Leilei Chen, Zhifeng Liu, Yucan Zheng
pmc-10686022.description: Anorexia nervosa (AN) has a high mortality rate due to the widespread organ dysfunction caused by the underlying severe malnutrition. Malnutrition-induced hepatitis is common among individuals with AN especially as body mass index decreases, while acute liver failure and aplastic crisis related to coagulation disease and encephalopathy rarely occur in AN patients.

pmc-11339408.title: Inhibition of Caspase-1-dependent pyroptosis alleviates myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury during cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) in type 2 diabetic rats
pmc-11339408.creator: Wenjing Zhou, Yingya Yang, Zhouheng Feng, Yu Zhang, Yiman Chen, Tian Yu, Haiying Wang
pmc-11339408.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Cardiovascular complications pose a significant burden in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), driven by the intricate interplay of chronic hyperglycemia, insulin resistance, and lipid metabolism disturbances. Myocardial ischemia/reperfusion (MI/R) injury during cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) exacerbates cardiac vulnerability. This study aims to probe the role of Caspase-1-dependent pyroptosis in global ischemia/reperfusion injury among T2DM rats undergoing CPB, elucidating the mechanisms underlying heightened myocardial injury in T2DM.

pmc-11467239.title: Soluble transferrin receptor is associated with red blood cell transfusion in infant cardiac surgery
pmc-11467239.creator: Peng Gao, Jia Liu, He Wang, Wenting Wang, Yu Jin, Peiyao Zhang, Jinping Liu
pmc-11467239.description: BackgroundIron deficiency (ID) is linked to an increased need for perioperative red blood cell (RBC) transfusion in cardiac surgery. Traditional markers used to assess ID are often influenced by inflammation, whereas soluble transferrin receptor (sTfR) is less affected by inflammation.

pmc-11522491.title: Cerebral hemodynamic plasticity related to potential compensatory self-recirculation network in Moyamoya disease: an observational study
pmc-11522491.creator: Lei Cao, Xiaoli Yuan, Yang Dong, Zeming Wang, Mengguo Guo, Dongpeng Li, Hao Wang, Lingyun Zhu, Bo Yang, Hongwei Li
pmc-11522491.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Moyamoya disease (MMD) suffers from impaired cerebrovascular hemodynamics and high perioperative complications occurrence. This study aims to propose and evaluate the relationship between intraoperative hemodynamics and perioperative complications, and propose a potential compensatory self-recirculation network in MMD. We prospectively enrolled 63 MMD patients undergone combined revascularization, and patients were divided into decreased and increased group according to decreased and increased microvascular transit time (MVTT), respectively. Mean age of all patients was 45.9 ± 9.4 years.

pmc-11551923.title: Rheumatic Fever Unveiled in a 13-Year-Old Misdiagnosed With Appendicitis
pmc-11551923.creator: Adil M Alsumm, Nabil S Dhayhi, Hamad M Alakshum, Abdullah A Yatimi, Abdullah H Alhamoud
pmc-11551923.description: Rheumatic fever (RF) remains a significant global health concern, particularly in regions with limited access to health care. Despite its association with group A streptococcal infections, diagnosing RF can be challenging because of its diverse clinical presentations, including cardiac manifestations such as heart block.

pmc-11679678.title: ZnO–Polyaniline Nanocomposite Functionalised with Laccase Enzymes for Electrochemical Detection of Cetyltrimethylammonuium Bromide (CTAB)
pmc-11679678.creator: Hilda Dinah Kyomuhimbo, Usisipho Feleni, Nils Hendrik Haneklaus, Hendrik Gideon Brink
pmc-11679678.description: The direct discharge of cationic surfactants into environmental matrices has exponentially increased due to their wide application in many products. These compounds and their degraded products disrupt microbial dynamics, hinder plant survival, and affect human health. Therefore, there is an urgent need to develop electroanalytical assessment techniques for their identification, determination, and monitoring.

pmc-12592349.title: Setd2 ensures the establishment of a precise basal inflammatory state within murine hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells
pmc-12592349.creator: Hong Tao, Xinyue Luo, Jiachun Song, Fuhui Wang, Yinyin Xie, Rong Fan, Xiaojian Sun, Qiuhua Huang, Yuanliang Zhang
pmc-12592349.description: The maintenance of a basal immunoinflammatory signature in hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells (HSPCs) constitutes a fundamental regulatory axis governing hematopoietic competence and immune effector generation. While epigenetic repressors constrain this inflammatory phenotype, the molecular amplifiers that preserve this critical state remain undefined.

pmc-12639130.title: Rapid single-flux-quantum and adiabatic quantum-flux-parametron cell libraries using a 1 kA/cm2 niobium fabrication process
pmc-12639130.creator: Taiki Yamae, Yuki Hironaka, Shuichi Nagasawa, Yuki Yamanashi, Nobuyuki Yoshikawa, Naoki Takeuchi
pmc-12639130.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Superconductor logic families can operate with small power dissipation and are thus suitable as building blocks for various computing systems. In some applications, superconductor logic circuits should be designed using Josephson junctions with low Ic values (Ic: critical current). For instance, lowering Ic values enables qubit interface circuits to operate with very small power dissipation at ~10 mK and stochastic electronics to easily induce stochastic operations.

pmc-12841841.title: Biochemical Markers Involved in Bone Remodelling During Orthodontic Tooth Movement
pmc-12841841.creator: Beatriz Patricia Fuentes Vera, Ibrahim Dib Zaitun, María Ángeles Pérez de la Cruz
pmc-12841841.description: Bone remodelling is a physiological process influenced by mechanical stimuli such as those generated during orthodontic treatment. Biochemical markers allow the phases of remodelling to be identified, its progression to be assessed, alterations to be detected and scaffold-based tissue regeneration to be evaluated. This study reviews the main markers involved in bone formation and resorption, highlighting their clinical relevance.

pmc-13234433.title: Retinal microvascular alterations consistent with endothelial dysregulation in paediatric post-COVID-19 syndrome: A prospective matched-cohort study
pmc-13234433.creator: Pia-Sophie Lamprecht, Lukas Streese, Christoph Hauser, Henner Hanssen, Michael Lorenz, Sascha Klee, Hans Proquitté, Daniel Vilser
pmc-13234433.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Persistent symptoms following SARS-CoV-2 infection in children remain poorly understood, and objective biological correlates are scarce. The vascular endothelium is considered a central target of post-viral dysregulation, yet paediatric evidence for microvascular involvement is limited. Retinal imaging enables non-invasive assessment of microvascular structure and function and may help to clarify whether endothelial dysregulation is present in children with post-COVID-19 syndrome (PCS). Retinal vessel diameters and flicker-induced vasoreactivity were assessed at baseline and after a median of 14 weeks.

pmc-13247758.title: Robotic transabdominal pre-peritoneal repair of a bilateral inguinal hernia: a surgical technique displaying an educational roadmap using Furtado’s 5 triangles concept
pmc-13247758.creator: Valentin Butnari, Parvathi Nambiar, Ahmer Mansuri, Sayed Haschmat Sarwary, Joseph Huang, Nirooshun Rajendran, Richard Boulton, Matthew Hanson, Sandeep Kaul
pmc-13247758.description: Minimally invasive repair of inguinal hernias offers several advantages over the conventional open approach in the context of reduced postoperative pain and faster return to daily activities with a non-inferior recurrence rate. With the increasing adoption of robotic platforms in surgical units worldwide, robotic transabdominal pre-peritoneal (rTAPP) repair has become an increasingly popular option offered to the patients.

pmc-13307689.title: Epidemiological and Virological Characteristics of H9N2 Avian Influenza Virus in Jiangsu Province, China, 2024
pmc-13307689.creator: Xue Gao, Huiyan Yu, Na Zhang, Liqi Liu, Jing Tong, Xian Qi, Haodi Huang, Shenjiao Wang, Zi Li, Yangguang Du, Liguo Zhu

pmc-13349092.title: Interpretable machine learning with Bayesian optimization for bond strength prediction of steel reinforcement in geopolymer concrete
pmc-13349092.creator: Viet Hung Tran, Viet Hai Hoang, Quang Minh Tran
pmc-13349092.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Accurate estimation of bond strength between steel reinforcement and geopolymer concrete is essential for the reliable design of sustainable reinforced concrete structures. However, the highly nonlinear interactions reduce the applicability and accuracy of conventional empirical models. This study proposes a Bayesian-optimized interpretable machine learning framework to predict the ultimate bond strength of reinforced geopolymer concrete using a comprehensive experimental database compiled from published studies.

pmc-13503706.title: Zinc-phosphorus nanodomains with dynamic coordination for electrochemical CO2 reduction
pmc-13503706.creator: Guiru Zhang, Ning Ji, Liuxuan Luo, Xiangrui Li, Peng Shen, Rui Xue, Shu Yuan, Junyi Huang, Congfan Zhao, Tianzi Bi, Xiaojing Cheng, Yangge Guo, Xiaohui Yan, Xiaozhi Su, Shuiyun Shen, Junliang Zhang
pmc-13503706.description: Single-atom catalysts (SACs) are favored owing to their well-defined motifs and notable CO selectivity in electrochemical CO2 reduction. However, the dynamic coordination evolution under working conditions and the structure-activity relationships remain highly puzzling. Herein, we suggest that flexible Zn–P3 nanodomains with weak-bond interactions may exhibit a potential-dependent structural modulation under working conditions compared to Zn–N4 configurations.

pmc-13564855.title: Revolutionising healthcare access: student-led clinics as catalysts for change in an underserved urban community in Karachi, Pakistan
pmc-13564855.creator: Syed Muhammad Aqeel Abidi, Ali Hyder Nazeer, Bilal Lodhi, Syeda Kainat Fatima, Fatima Abdullah, Muhammad Ali Akbar Khan, Maheen Zakaria, Ali Azan Ahmed, Aly Hamza Khowaja
pmc-13564855.description: BackgroundKarachi, Pakistan’s largest metropolitan city, faces profound healthcare disparities, with an estimated 45–49% of the population residing in underserved informal settlements. Within these communities, the primary healthcare system is not merely under-resourced but structurally fractured, leaving patients to navigate prohibitively expensive private providers or overcrowded public hospitals.

[FR Doc No: 97-5554] ----------------------------------------------------------------------- DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY Tax on Certain Imported Substances (Epoxy); Notice of Determination AGENCY: Internal Revenue Service (IRS), Treasury. ACTION: Notice. ----------------------------------------------------------------------- SUMMARY: This notice announces a determination, under Notice 89-61, that the list of taxable substances in section 4672(a)(3) will be modified to include diglycidyl ether of bisphenol-A. EFFECTIVE.
